what: The big photo cross-fades to the next one every 4s over 3s (Swiper fade), and in the row of four small photos below only the current one has its white cover (.7) lifted over .3s so it looks sharp. Clicking a small photo jumps to that slide. It advances only while the gallery is within 100px of the bottom of the screen and stops when it leaves

options.[data-fx-part=thumbs] (same type): Small photo row (child) — if absent, only the large photo rotates
options.per: Number of small photo slots, default 4
options.margin: Distance (px) from the bottom of the screen before it starts turning, default 100
